# Bridge Maintenance Report (BMR)

* Report No. 1
* Project: Infrastructure Inspection and Evaluation of Maintained Bridges and Structures
* Date: September 6, 2019
* Location: Singapore, River Valley Bridge
* Report submitted by: [Name]
* Work Supervisor/Engineer: [Engineer Name]
* Report Purpose: To present the findings of the Maintenance Inspection done on River Valley Bridge 

## 1.2 Introduction

This report outlines the structural defects found during the inspection and evaluation of the bridge, along with suggestions for necessary repairs and maintenance work.
# 1.3 Overview of method of evaluation

- Observations were made on the entire structure for macro level defects along with detailed investigations of all the steel members with a detailed analysis. 

- The following aspects were considered during the inspection: 
- 1. External condition of the bridge.
- 2. Macro

# Bridge Maintenance Report (BMR)

* Report No. 1
* Project: Infrastructure Inspection and Evaluation of Maintained Bridges and Structures
* Date: September 6, 2019
* Location: Singapore, River Valley Bridge
* Report submitted by: [Name]
* Work Supervisor/Engineer: [Engineer Name]
* Report Purpose: To present the findings of the Maintenance Inspection done on River Valley Bridge 

## 1.2 Introduction

This report outlines the structural defects found during the inspection and evaluation of the bridge, along with suggestions for necessary repairs and maintenance work.
# 1.3 Overview of method of evaluation

- Observations were made on the entire structure for macro level defects along with detailed investigations of all the steel members with a detailed analysis. 

- The following aspects were considered during the inspection: 
- 1. External condition of the bridge.
- 2. Macro
